حَذَمَانٌ Quickness in walking or going: (K:) accord. to Aboo-'Adnán, a pace of the kind termed ذَمِيلٌ, exceeding what is termed مَشْىٌ. (TA.) ―
-b2- And Slowness (K, TA) in walking or going: so says Aboo-'Adnán on the authority of Khálid Ibn-Jembeh. (TA.) Thus it bears two contrary meanings. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
